devdoc.details: Holds all ETH contributions. Releases or refunds on instruction      from the authorized StartupFund contract only.      Uses CEI (Checks-Effects-Interactions) pattern on all ETH transfers.

campaignBalance(uint256).details: Returns total ETH held for a campaign (sum of all contributor deposits).

deposit(uint256,address).details: Records a contribution for campaignId from contributor.      ETH is sent directly to this contract (via StartupFund forwarding msg.value).

getContribution(uint256,address).details: Returns the contribution amount for a specific contributor.

getContributors(uint256).details: Returns all contributor addresses for a campaign.

issueRefund(uint256,address).details: Refunds a single contributor's contribution for campaignId.      Called by StartupFund.claimRefund() after campaign is cancelled.      CEI: zero out balance before transferring ETH.

releaseFunds(uint256,address).details: Releases the full campaign balance to the creator.      Called by StartupFund.withdraw() after goal is met.      CEI: mark released before transferring ETH.

setAuthorized(address).details: Called once after StartupFund is deployed.
